title: The Tamura-Nei (1993) nucleotide exchangeability matrix

citation.title: Estimation of the number of nucleotide substitutions in the control region of mitochondrial DNA in humans and chimpanzees.

args.name: kappaPyr
args.description: Relative rate of C↔T transitions (C↔U for RNA)

description: Symmetric exchangeability matrix with relative rate kappaPur for A↔G transitions and kappaPyr for C↔T transitions (C↔U for RNA). Transversions have relative rate 1. Combine with F to supply equilibrium frequencies, or FE for equal frequencies.
